voices.note: anonymous redactorial voice of this sugya
דתניא, R' Eliezer on the louse
the Rabbis who dispute R' Eliezer on killing a louse

props.gloss_en: the mishna: other abominations and crawling things -- one who wounds them is exempt
hence, one who kills them is liable
R' Yirmeya: the tanna [holding that killing them is liable] is R' Eliezer
R' Eliezer: one who kills a louse on Shabbat is like one who kills a camel on Shabbat
Rav Yosef: the Rabbis dispute R' Eliezer only on the louse, which does not procreate
but other abominations and crawling things, which procreate -- they [the Rabbis] do not dispute [that killing them is liable]
and both learned it only from the rams
R' Eliezer: as rams have taking of life, so whatever has taking of life
the Rabbis: as rams procreate, so whatever procreates
Mar: the Holy One sits and sustains [all], from the horns of re'eimim to the eggs of lice
it is a species that is called 'eggs of lice'
the baraita: tifuyin and eggs of lice
one who traps a flea on Shabbat: R' Eliezer holds him liable
Rav Ashi: are you setting trapping against killing? R' Eliezer and R' Yehoshua dispute only [over trapping]
one [R' Eliezer] holds: a thing whose kind is not trapped -- [one who traps it is] liable
but regarding killing [a flea, which procreates], even R' Yehoshua concedes [that one is liable]
